name: universal-qa-agent
description: Learn automation repositories and turn Jira requirements into reviewable tests.

interface.longDescription: For QA engineers and developers: inspect an automation repository, approve its framework and convention profile, then turn Jira requirements into traceable scenarios, coverage gaps, and an implementation plan. Apply code changes only after approval. Uses project test-case templates when verified, with CSV as a fallback. Requires local Git, Python 3.10+, PyYAML, jsonschema, and a private profile store. Jira access comes from the active agent's integration or issue content supplied by the user. Verification commands require explicit approval. Host permissions govern tool access; the plugin does not provide Jira authentication or enforce tool-level permissions.
defaultPrompt: Onboard this automation repository and show its profile for approval.
Analyze a Jira issue using the approved profile and propose test scenarios and an implementation plan.
